content.text: Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters, Gen. 1:2 (Moses 2:2; Abr. 4:2). My spirit shall not always strive with man, Gen. 6:3 (Ether 2:15; D&C 1:33; Moses 8:17). I will take of the spirit which is upon thee, Num. 11:17. Joshua … in whom is the spirit, Num. 27:18. evil spirit from the Lord troubled him, 1 Sam. 16:14 (19:9). Seek me a woman that hath a familiar spirit, 1 Sam. 28:7. let a double portion of thy spirit be upon me, 2 Kgs. 2:9. the pattern of all that he had by the spirit, 1 Chr. 28:12. Thou gavest also thy good spirit to instruct, Neh. 9:20. a spirit passed before my face, Job 4:15. Into thine hand I commit my spirit, Ps. 31:5 (Luke 23:46). in whose spirit there is no guile, Ps. 32:2. Lord … saveth such as be of a contrite spirit, Ps. 34:18. renew a right spirit within me, Ps. 51:10. sacrifices of God are a broken spirit, Ps. 51:17. generation … whose spirit was not steadfast with God, Ps. 78:8. Who maketh his angels spirits, Ps. 104:4 (Heb. 1:7). Whither shall I go from thy spirit, Ps. 139:7. my God: thy spirit is good, Ps. 143:10. I will pour out my spirit unto you, Prov. 1:23 (Isa. 32:15; 44:3; Joel 2:28; Acts 2:17; Jacob 7:8; Mosiah 4:20; Alma 8:10). Lord weigheth the spirits, Prov. 16:2. he that ruleth his spirit, Prov. 16:32. man of understanding is of an excellent spirit, Prov. 17:27. spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity, Prov. 18:14. spirit of man is the candle of the Lord, Prov. 20:27. He that hath no rule over his own spirit, Prov. 25:28. no man that hath power over the spirit to retain the spirit, Eccl. 8:8. thou knowest not what is the way of the spirit, Eccl. 11:5. spirit shall return unto God who gave it, Eccl. 12:7. spirit of the Lord shall rest upon him, Isa. 11:2. Who hath directed the Spirit of the Lord, or … taught, Isa. 40:13 (40:7). I have put my spirit upon him, Isa. 42:1 (Matt. 12:18). I will pour my spirit upon thy seed, Isa. 44:3. whither the spirit was to go, they went, Ezek. 1:12. spirit of the living creature was in the wheels, Ezek. 1:20 (1:21; 10:17). spirit entered into me when he spake unto me, Ezek. 2:2. spirit took me up, and I heard, Ezek. 3:12. spirit lifted me up between the earth, Ezek. 8:3 (11:1, 24; 43:5). I will put a new spirit within you, Ezek. 11:19 (36:26–27; 37:14). in whom is the spirit of the holy gods, Dan. 4:8 (5:11). Daniel was preferred … because an excellent spirit was in him, Dan. 6:3. spirit of whoredoms hath caused them to err, Hosea 4:12. I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh, Joel 2:28 (Acts 2:17). my spirit remaineth among you, Hag. 2:5. Not by might … but by my spirit, Zech. 4:6. the four spirits of the heavens, Zech. 6:5.

Jesus led up of the Spirit into the wilderness, Matt. 4:1 (Mark 1:12; Luke 4:1). Blessed are the poor in spirit, Matt. 5:3 (3 Ne. 12:3). he cast out the spirits with his word, Matt. 8:16. he gave them power against unclean spirits, Matt. 10:1 (Mark 6:7). it is not ye that speak, but the Spirit of your Father, Matt. 10:20. When the unclean spirit is gone out of a man, Matt. 12:43 (Luke 11:24). taketh with himself seven other spirits, Matt. 12:45 (Luke 11:26). saying, It is a spirit, Matt. 14:26 (Mark 6:49). Spirit like a dove descending upon him, Mark 1:10 (John 1:32). Come out of the man, thou unclean spirit, Mark 5:8. my spirit hath rejoiced in God, Luke 1:47. commandeth the unclean spirits, and they come out, Luke 4:36. Ye know not what manner of spirit ye are of, Luke 9:55. into thy hands I commend my spirit, Luke 23:46. supposed that they had seen a spirit, Luke 24:37. spirit hath not flesh and bones, as ye see me, Luke 24:39. born of water and of the Spirit, John 3:5. that which is born of the Spirit is spirit, John 3:6. canst not tell whence it cometh … that is born of the Spirit, John 3:8. God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit, John 4:24. It is the spirit that quickeneth, John 6:63. this spake he of the Spirit, John 7:39. Spirit of truth; whom the world cannot receive, John 14:17. Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, John 15:26. when he, the Spirit of truth, is come, John 16:13. speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance, Acts 2:4. Stephen … saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit, Acts 7:59. Spirit said unto Philip, Go near, Acts 8:29. Spirit said unto him, Behold, three men seek thee, Acts 10:19. signified by the Spirit that there should be great dearth, Acts 11:28. I go bound in the spirit unto Jerusalem, Acts 20:22. Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, neither angel, nor spirit, Acts 23:8. declared to be the Son of God with power, according to the spirit, Rom. 1:4. in the spirit, and not in the letter, Rom. 2:29. we should serve in newness of spirit, Rom. 7:6. walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit, Rom. 8:1 (8:4). law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free, Rom. 8:2. they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit, Rom. 8:5. if any man have not the Spirit of Christ, he is none of his, Rom. 8:9. Spirit is life because of righteousness, Rom. 8:10. if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, Rom. 8:13. Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, Rom. 8:16. Spirit itself maketh intercession for us, Rom. 8:26. he … knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit, Rom. 8:27. my speech … in demonstration of the Spirit, 1 Cor. 2:4. God hath revealed them unto us by his Spirit, 1 Cor. 2:10. we have received, not the spirit of the world, but the spirit which is of God, 1 Cor. 2:12. natural man receiveth not the things of the Spirit, 1 Cor. 2:14. spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord, 1 Cor. 5:5. justified … by the Spirit of our God, 1 Cor. 6:11. glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, 1 Cor. 6:20. diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit, 1 Cor. 12:4. manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man, 1 Cor. 12:7 (12:1–11). given by the Spirit the word of wisdom, 1 Cor. 12:8. to another discerning of spirits, 1 Cor. 12:10. by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body, 1 Cor. 12:13. last Adam was made a quickening spirit, 1 Cor. 15:45. written not with ink, but with the Spirit, 2 Cor. 3:3. letter killeth, but the spirit giveth life, 2 Cor. 3:6. Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, Gal. 3:2. that we might receive the promise of the Spirit, Gal. 3:14. we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness, Gal. 5:5. Walk in the Spirit, Gal. 5:16. flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh, Gal. 5:17. fruit of the Spirit is love, Gal. 5:22. we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit, Gal. 5:25. he that soweth to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting, Gal. 6:8. we both have access by one Spirit unto the Father, Eph. 2:18. strengthened with might by his Spirit, Eph. 3:16. keep the unity of the Spirit, Eph. 4:3. be renewed in the spirit of your mind, Eph. 4:23. fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness, Eph. 5:9. be filled with the Spirit, Eph. 5:18. take … the sword of the Spirit, Eph. 6:17. supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ, Philip. 1:19. stand fast in one spirit, Philip. 1:27. If there be … any fellowship of the Spirit, Philip. 2:1. Quench not the Spirit, 1 Thes. 5:19. God was … justified in the Spirit, 1 Tim. 3:16. Spirit speaketh expressly, 1 Tim. 4:1. Are they not all ministering spirits, Heb. 1:14. spirits of just men made perfect, Heb. 12:23 (D&C 129:3). spirit that dwelleth in us lusteth to envy, James 4:5. quickened by the Spirit, 1 Pet. 3:18. live according to God in the spirit, 1 Pet. 4:6. he abideth in us, by the Spirit, 1 Jn. 3:24. believe not every spirit, but try the spirits, 1 Jn. 4:1. Hereby know we the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error, 1 Jn. 4:6. he hath given us of his Spirit, 1 Jn. 4:13. it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is truth, 1 Jn. 5:6. three that bear witness in earth, the Spirit, and the water, and the blood, 1 Jn. 5:8. sensual, having not the Spirit, Jude 1:19. I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, Rev. 1:10. let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches, Rev. 2:7. the seven Spirits of God, Rev. 3:1 (4:5). Spirit of life from God entered into them, Rev. 11:11. they are the spirits of devils, Rev. 16:14. testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy, Rev. 19:10.

I was led by the Spirit, not knowing beforehand, 1 Ne. 4:6. his Spirit, hath sent me, 1 Ne. 20:16. by the Spirit are all things made known, 1 Ne. 22:2. this I speak because of the spirit which is in me, 2 Ne. 25:11. if ye would hearken unto the Spirit which teacheth, 2 Ne. 32:8. Spirit speaketh the truth and lieth not, Jacob 4:13. he has poured out his Spirit upon you, Mosiah 4:20. know of their surety and truth, because of the Spirit, Mosiah 5:2. may pour out his Spirit more abundantly upon you, Mosiah 18:10. I am born of the Spirit, Mosiah 27:24. spirit which they listed to obey, Alma 3:26. in mighty prayer, that he would pour out his Spirit, Alma 8:10. say nothing which is contrary to the Spirit, Alma 11:22. Lord did begin to pour out his Spirit, Alma 19:36. receive his Spirit, that I may be filled with joy, Alma 22:15. that ye will still resist the spirit of the truth, Alma 30:46. he was taken up by the Spirit, Alma 45:19. always remember me ye shall have my Spirit, 3 Ne. 18:7. this body … is the body of my spirit, Ether 3:16. may always have his Spirit to be with them, Moro. 4:3 (5:2; D&C 20:77, 79). gifts are … given by the manifestations of the Spirit, Moro. 10:8.

Spirit beareth record, D&C 1:39. with the manifestation of my Spirit … even of water, D&C 5:16. enlightened by the Spirit of truth, D&C 6:15. this is the spirit of revelation, D&C 8:3. put your trust in that Spirit which leadeth to do good, D&C 11:12 (11:18). tongue be loosed … you shall have my Spirit, D&C 11:21. by the power of my Spirit have spoken it, D&C 18:47 (18:2, 35). at the time I withdrew my Spirit, D&C 19:20 (19:18, 23). they have received of the Spirit of Christ, D&C 20:37. according as it shall be given thee by my Spirit, D&C 25:7. sword of my Spirit, D&C 27:18. created by … power of my Spirit, D&C 29:30. not given heed unto my Spirit, D&C 30:2. power of my Spirit quickeneth all things, D&C 33:16. thresh the nations by the power of my Spirit, D&C 35:13. if ye receive not the Spirit ye shall not teach, D&C 42:14. looketh upon a woman to lust … shall not have the Spirit, D&C 42:23 (63:16). teach … by the power of my Spirit, D&C 43:15. may not be seduced by evil spirits, D&C 46:7. Spirit may be given to every man to profit, D&C 46:16. he that asketh in Spirit shall receive in Spirit, D&C 46:28. spirits which have gone abroad in the earth, D&C 50:1. many spirits which are false spirits, D&C 50:2. preach my gospel by the Spirit, D&C 50:14. received ye spirits which ye could not understand, D&C 50:15 (50:31). holding my Spirit from the inhabitants, D&C 63:32. I … withheld my Spirit, D&C 64:16. by my Spirit will I enlighten them, D&C 76:10. sanctified by the Spirit, D&C 84:33. whatsoever is light is Spirit, D&C 84:45. my Spirit shall be in your hearts, D&C 84:88. my voice is Spirit; my Spirit is truth, D&C 88:66. man is spirit, D&C 93:33. that I may pour out my Spirit upon all flesh, D&C 95:4. I speak unto you with … the voice of my Spirit, D&C 97:1. write according to that which shall be dictated by my Spirit, D&C 104:81. manifest … by the voice of the Spirit, D&C 105:36. power of my Spirit, that shall flow unto you, D&C 111:8. hearken to the voice of my Spirit, D&C 112:22. moved upon by my Spirit, D&C 124:88. All spirit is matter, D&C 131:7. my Spirit is sent forth into the world, D&C 136:33. awaiting the advent of the Son of God into the spirit world, D&C 138:16. spirit and the body to be united never again to be divided, D&C 138:17. Son of God preached unto the spirits in prison, D&C 138:28. in the world of spirits, instructing and preparing the faithful spirits of the prophets, D&C 138:36. choice spirits who were reserved to come forth, D&C 138:53. under the bondage of sin in the great world of the spirits of the dead, D&C 138:57.

his Spirit hath not altogether withdrawn, Moses 1:15. my Spirit moved upon the face of the water, Moses 2:2. write by the spirit of inspiration, Moses 6:5. my Spirit is upon you, Moses 6:34. he beheld the spirits that God had created, Moses 6:36. born into the world by water, and blood, and the spirit, Moses 6:59. as many of the spirits as were in prison came forth, Moses 7:57. he stood among those that were spirits, Abr. 3:23.
